batch: Source-Identity Leakage and Geometry-Relative Transfer Falsification
branch: Selective_Recompute (isolated paths experiments/fnto_srcid78, results/fnto_srcid78; no worktree)
question: Is source-identifying spatial conditioning a material cause of the rank-16 learned-K boundary-transfer failure, and can removing that dependence improve independent source generalization without losing physical fidelity or computational feasibility?

stage0.evidence: archived, already-scored development data only (S16-R training bundles; the WL75 Stage 3 population mirrored to ~/rest_rank75L, hash-identical to the local WL75 originals); the WL77A Part 0 references were not opened
findings: A75 reads node[:, :16] only: absolute rest and current position (6), material-axis normal (3), ordinal face id (1) + local deformation / area / thickness / normal spread; pair inputs: material-axis offsets, |dr|, distance, n.n; the global dent grid is not read (WL77A listed it: corrected)

UV path: source-independent global receiver distributions U (softmax over all ports) addressed by a source loading V(z_i): an absolute-position-keyed lookup channel; no source-indexed parameter table exists

class 1 (whole-geometry rigid motion) is an exact invariance of A75 by construction (material-frame features); absolute-position conditioning can only matter for class 2 (translation within the finite slab) and class 3 (slab symmetries)

the three historical boundary-far pairs 101<-50 (mx + z-flip, +22.5 mm), 105<-52 (z-flip, -30 mm), 107<-53 (z-flip, +22.5 mm) are full-response physical equivalences within reference noise at every distance stratum (0-5 mm: 99-99.9 % of the native signal, difference 0.002 = noise; fine16 contrast 0.005 = noise); the second-boundary distance change (18.75 -> 41-49 mm) is not measurable

A75 predictions for these equivalent contexts differ in the near field by 0.12-0.33 (native) and 0.42-1.41 (fine16 contrast), with far-source errors 1.3-2.8x the supervised analogues; the difference is in the W path (UV share ~0 within 10 mm)
outside the 128-NN W support: 5.5 / 3.2 / 0.1 % of collided energy (R/G/B) for interior sources, 1-2 % for boundary sources; native and contrast L2 signal outside ~0
a constant origin offset of the absolute-coordinate inputs alone (physically identical) changes A75 predictions for boundary training source s50 by 9-23 % (error 0.12 -> 0.15-0.26); interior s0 1-2 %

hypothesis: A75 encodes the source position through absolute-coordinate and material-axis-orientation inputs; for boundary sources these keys select a supervised-source-specific near-field response, so physically equivalent unsupervised contexts receive a different response. Replacing those inputs by geometry-relative boundary context expressed in each port bin frame (W+UV-Q) maps physically equivalent contexts to identical or frame-rotated inputs; with the same operator, capacity and training, supervised fidelity is kept and independent boundary-far contrast error falls.
why_not_information_loss: the removed inputs carry no physics beyond the boundary context that the new inputs encode within 20 mm (Stage 0: no measurable response change from boundaries >= 18.75 mm; no measurable signal beyond the W support in L2); the removed far-field localisation of U carries 1-5.5 % of collided energy and ~0 of the scored L2 signal; the bin frame orientation that A75 read implicitly from the material-axis normal / face id is supplied explicitly by frame-expressed vectors, which is the representation consistent with the frame-defined A/O bins
unchanged: K/C ownership, first-exit semantics, ballistic B and beta, homogeneous material, 16 incoming / 64 outgoing bins, rank 16, frozen G2 A/O (rank75.basis), W+UV algebra and passivity normalisation (rank75.TransportM), node graph (16-NN) and edges (128-NN) and the distance prior, layer shapes and parameter count, S16-R training population (rest, pt0) and fitting replicas 0-3, objective J + 1.0 L_sym, Adam, cosine 3e-3 -> 3e-5, 20,000 steps, clip 1.0, checkpoints 2k/6k/10k, final iterate, eval68 estimators and eval73 groups / qualification

candidate.name: W+UV-Q (W+UV with geometry-relative, source-identity-free conditioning)
node_features: 0-2 rest->current displacement in the port bin frame / 6 mm
3-5 area ratio, thickness / 1 cm, normal spread (A75 columns 12-14 bitwise)
6-9 boundary probe 1: unit offset in the port frame x w1, w1 = max(0, 1 - r1/20 mm)^2
candidate.probes: probe 1 = nearest port (current positions) with |n_j . n_i| < 0.5 (area-averaged normals); probe 2 = nearest such port also with |n_j . n_probe1| < 0.5; the cut-offs 20 mm / 5 mm are fixed (20 mm >= the W support radius 13.5-17 mm and the red diffusion length 18 mm; 5 mm = the near field)
candidate.pair_features: rest offset x0_j - x0_i in the source port bin frame / 1 cm + A75 pair columns 3-5 bitwise
candidate.removed: absolute rest / current position (6), material-axis normal (3), ordinal face id (1), material-axis pair offsets (3 -> frame-expressed)
candidate.frame: the bin frame of a port = the (t, b, n) frame of its first triangle (the frame in which its 16 incoming / 64 outgoing bins are defined); at rest it is constant per face
candidate.transformation_law: class 1: inputs invariant (material frame); class 2: identical inputs wherever the boundary context within 20 mm (and the local deformation) is equal; class 3: inputs of the image port = per-port frame map applied to the vector blocks, scalars equal (except predeclared probe-1 tie ports: equal distance to two perpendicular boundaries, 176 at rest)
limitations: probe-1 ties (176 ports at rest) break exact quotient consistency there
frame-rotated equivalent contexts (e.g. 101 <- 50, a 90-degree frame map) are different inputs; transfer between them is a learned generalisation, not an identity
U loses absolute receiver localisation: far-field (beyond W support) transport becomes context-only (1-5.5 % of collided energy)
A/O are global in port frames; exact angular equivariance under frame-rotating operations is not attainable without changing A/O (unchanged by contract)
candidate.initialization: rank75.init_model (P_590x trunk bitwise, rank-dependent rows r mod 8, frozen G2 A/O) for every tensor except encoder.weight, encoder.bias, pair_layer.weight, which read the replaced inputs and are re-initialised with the PyTorch default Linear initialisation under torch.manual_seed(reinit_seed); recorded as a confound
candidate.expected_cost: parameters and runtime state identical to A75; geometry rebuild adds the input construction (frames + O(P^2) boundary-probe distances on the GPU); apply identical

optimizer.objective: J (WL68 objective, rank-generic ato74.objective_m) + 1.0 * L_sym (WL72 exact-symmetry consistency)
optimizer.training_data: S16-R fit_targets73.pt (fitting replicas 0-3), rest and pt0; WL72 pt0 symmetry-image geometries

predictions: P1 supervised fidelity within 1.25x of A75 on S16-R held-out replicas
P2 the near-field difference between equivalent-context predictions (Stage 0 pairs) falls to <= 0.5x A75 (mechanism criterion)
P3 independent BND_FAR coarse contrast improves by >= 20 % over the stronger learned control in both seeds
P4 no material BND_NEAR / INT / footprint regression

stage2.tests: test78.py T1-T11 (capacity / no source table, initialisation, wrapper and source/receiver/angular correspondence, physics at rest/pt0/te1 incl. a perturbed model, rebuild consistency, whole-geometry rigid motion, all 15 slab operations (frame-map law), negative control on six boundary contexts, origin independence, decision logic, Stage 4 isolation); any failure stops

stage3.data: S16-R held-out replicas 4-7 (eval73.load_refs / evaluate, the WL75 Stage 2 path)

gate.rule: each Q78 seed: hi (worst-channel jackknife upper 95 %) <= 1.25 x max over the A75 seeds for every group/metric; validity: every passivity check (rest, pt0, cf3, cf2, te2, te0) passed and A/O bitwise the frozen basis; both seeds must pass
gate.outcomes: FIT GATE PASSED -> Stage 4; INSUFFICIENT FIT -> stop (mechanism diagnostics on development data, cost, export); PHYSICAL VALIDITY FAILURE -> stop

stage3.descriptive: checkpoints, con_native / con_fine16, per-matrix values, run records

mechanism.criterion: mean over the pairs 101<-50, 105<-52, 107<-53 of the worst-channel near-field (0-5 mm) relative difference between the far-source prediction and the mapped training-source prediction; improved iff Q78/A75 <= 0.5 for native and for fine16 contrast in both seeds (5901 vs 5901, 5902 vs 5902)
mechanism.descriptive: per-stratum errors, origin-offset sensitivity, WL75 Stage 3 population per-source errors (development, already scored in WL75)

stage4.population: WL77A Part 0 = the WL76 Stage 4 population (fnto_fia76/ports76.py, geometry only), never scored; references generated by WL77A before any WL78 candidate existed and never opened before this protocol was committed
stage4.qualification: eval73 rule unchanged: abs signal/SE >= 10 per matrix, deformation >= 3; a group needs >= 4 qualified matrices, otherwise UNMEASURED
stage4.evaluated: AR_5901/5902 (WL73), A75_5901/5902 (WL75), Q78_5901/5902 finals on replicas 0-3 (and 1-3 per matrix); checkpoints of A75 and Q78 descriptive only (no selection)

decision.stronger: per group, the preserved learned control (AR or A75) with the lower mean over its two seeds of con_coarse hi
decision.far_rule: far = YES iff max over Q78 seeds of BND_FAR con_coarse hi <= 0.8 x min over the stronger control seeds AND < min of their lower 95 % bounds; NO iff min Q78 > 0.8 x max stronger; else OVERLAP; near likewise on BND_NEAR
decision.regression_rule: per group/metric vs the better control (lower seed mean): YES iff min Q78 >= 1.25 x max control; NO iff max Q78 < 1.25 x min control; else OVERLAP
decision.verdicts: physics failure -> PHYSICAL VALIDITY FAILURE; far OVERLAP or primary unmeasured -> INCONCLUSIVE; far YES and mechanism improved -> SOURCE-IDENTITY LEAKAGE SUPPORTED; far YES, mechanism not improved -> CONDITIONING-ONLY TRANSFER BENEFIT; far NO and mechanism improved -> INVARIANCE IMPROVED, TRANSFER UNCHANGED; far NO otherwise -> NO TRANSFER BENEFIT; qualifiers: TRADE-OFF (regression YES with far YES), with regression, possible regression (overlap), LOCAL BENEFIT (BND_NEAR)
decision.absolute_gates: WL59: abs_coarse <= 0.10, abs_fine16 <= 0.15, con_coarse <= 0.25 per group; DEF relative <= 0.35 and corr >= 0.90 (eval73 Qdef); reported separately

stage4.analysis: per stratum: BND near/far, INT, SV (UNS), TOPBOT / SIDE, hi / lo coarse-cell sub-position, footprint and DEF; distance to S16-R from ports76.json; checkpoints (late-training specialisation)

stage5.rule: cost gate before training (initial W+UV-Q vs A75_5901, same GPU, same process): every gated ratio <= 2, else COST INFEASIBLE and stop; final cost measured again on the trained Q78_5901 (reported; limits unchanged)

execution.chain: tests -> cost gate -> full-scale probe -> two fits -> Stage 3 + fit gate -> mechanism diagnostics -> [pass: Stage 4] -> final cost -> export; one detached setsid process; any failure stops; dev smoke first (40-step fits, Stage 4 forced on dev slots, no metric used)
execution.lanes_rule: probe both runs concurrently with the real configuration; two lanes iff both complete and the sum of peak reserved memory <= 0.85 x GPU memory, else one lane (re-probed alone); a failed single-lane probe stops
execution.precision: float32 model and training (TF32 off), float64 estimators (eval68)
execution.hardware: LabServer63 RTX 3080 Ti 12 GB; WL75 A75 was trained on a local RTX 5080 (training time not comparable; operator costs re-measured on the same GPU)
